scope: All eight cells with Batch13 baseline / Batch14 candidate / reconstructed vLLM 0.27.1 interleaved in one attempt
sampling: greedy temperature0, original EOS and original request max_tokens
exclusion_policy: none; fail whole attempt, retain every sample and failed attempt
correctness_policy: Riley exact frozen token/text/finish reference; all engine input/output counts and transport exact; cross-engine arithmetic differences recorded
startup_timeout_scope: cold initialization only; captured logs and host samples; excluded from serving timing by explicit warmup and retained phase envelopes
host_clock_bridge: every host sample sandwiches epoch and CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW between perf_counter calls; request clock remains unchanged
batch_changes: Narrow decode captures: QK score and AV launch grids sized for at most 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 live rows, selected by the packet live-row count
Fused QKV parts, merge, RoPE and KV write dispatch in every shared32 grouped-attention decode capture (one kernel fewer per layer)
host_gate_revision: ORIGINAL gate v1 thresholds: cpu some<=5, io full<=5, memory full<=0.5, 3 consecutive samples within 300 s, otherwise the whole attempt aborts. io_soft_wait_seconds exceeds the timeout so the gate v2 soft path can never trigger.
comparability: same controller logic, fixtures, gate v1, warmup/retained counts, vLLM and Batch13 binary as kernel-batch13-gatev1; V52 and Batch12 lanes dropped (96 lanes); separate attempt, results not merged with Batch13 attempts

measured_motivation.source: Batch11 nsys profile c1-fixed r0 candidate; graph-replay microbenchmark grid_floor.cu
measured_motivation.finding: C1 decode is 9 kernels per layer (26 us); the QK score launch spends about 1.4 us per layer on blocks of inactive rows; QKV merge+RoPE is a separate 1.5 us dispatch

diagnostic_runs_before_plan: kernel-batch14-diagnostic-attempt01 single-lane A/B runs (variants b14a-b14f) guided development; they are not qualifying measurements and are preserved, including rejected variants b14a and b14d
environment_preparation: page cache of the vLLM venv is read once before launch; startup is outside all timed phases
